description.value: To survive an endless journey through the void at the outset of Azlanti space exploration, you transferred your soul into an aeon stone, eschewing your physical form to become an unaging aeonheart. You tended to your sleeping crewmates and maintained your starship as it slowly traversed the space between stars. Unlike modern hardlight projectors, your aeonheart core emits a magical hardlight shell that perfectly reflects the form you had before becoming an aeonheart. Your appearance must be a Medium Azlanti human. You gain Azlanti as a bonus language, and you can select ancestry feats from the human ancestry, in addition to the living hologram ancestry, as long as the feat doesn't require any physiological feature that you lack. Whenever you invest an aeon stone, you gain its resonant power.
